note: carhybrid/DESIGN.md phase P0: the team layout built by the pinned evolution builder, adapted to OpenFOAM, scored on the audit protocol (frames 0-1), and its coarse DAFoam gradient mapped to stage 2's 45 free-form numbers.
_domain_note: the trial car's frame (-0.005..0.265 m) is too short for whole cars (team layout: x 16.5..270.2 mm); background cell kept at the audited 22.5 mm: 12 x 0.290/0.270
_sweep1_note: readiness sweep, build only (no CFD): 24 scrambled-Sobol layouts over the 12 stage-1 genes (seed 20261128) and 8 stage-2 perturbations of the team layout (45 free-form numbers ~ N(0, 0.5), clipped +-2, as CMA's sigma 0.5)
_sweep1r_note: sweep1 relaunched before any of it ran (it was still queued), with a render and a shape audit of every car
_sweep2_note: the same 32 cars as sweep1/sweep1r, on the builder with evo_patches (mass: P1-P3; soft_cap: no flat deck, no sharp shelf, no step at the axles)
_p1_note: P1 gradient check, pre-registered in carhybrid/P1.md before any result: team layout, directions from the P0 gradient (carhybrid/results/p0/p0_team_dafoam/grad.json) by carhybrid/p1_cases.py, on the builder with every evo_patches fix (mass bookkeeping, soft cap v2, nose material); plus a DAFoam gradient on that base car.
_sweep3_note: sweep2's 32 cars rebuilt with soft cap v2 (the halo's visibility region compressed, not truncated) and the multi-material nose (evo_patches/nose_material.py); renders and shape audits.
_p1r_note: P1's three cases whose legal cars were lost to the adapter (half car not watertight after trimesh's vertex merge; carhybrid/adapt.py now keeps manifold's topology); same u, frames and names, results in results/p1r.
_f0_hosted_note: carhybrid/FINE_ADJOINT.md plumbing test on a hosted runner (4 cores, 16 GB + 13 GB swap): the team car, frame 0, bg_div 4.5 (~0.13 M cells: cells ~ bg_div^2.4 from 2.12 M at 12.889; bg_div 4.0 gave 96 k cells locally, but on the hosted runner its mesh crashed decomposePar with SIGFPE, the known failure of the layer stack on coarse walls), small enough for DAFoam's Krylov adjoint at ~150 kB/cell. The wall-resolved layers form only partly on these ~2 mm walls (locally at 4.0: mean 1.5 of 15 layers on the body). A plumbing test only: not the production mesh; gates F1-F3 are read, not judged, on it.
_f0_note: Gate F0, the adjoint memory law, on the AWS instance (carhybrid/aws/launch.sh f0): the team car, frame 0, bg_div 8.12 / 10.23 / 12.889 (~0.74 / 1.24 / 2.12 M cells, cells ~ bg_div^2.4); peak whole-machine memory per job in resources.json; passes if the three fit a line in cells and the line gives < 450 GB at 2.1 M.
_sweep4_note: sweep3's 32 layouts rebuilt with the nose block-front fix (e96a58a) and soft_cap v2.1; same names, results in results/sweep4
_aws_smoke_note: First AWS run (carhybrid/aws/launch.sh aws_smoke, r7i.4xlarge 16 vCPU / 128 GiB): the whole fine_adjoint chain on the 129 k-cell mesh the hosted plumbing test uses (bg_div 4.5, team car, frame 0): proves the instance setup, the score with its state kept, DAFoam D and L on that state, gates F1-F3, the gradient map and the S3 hand-back before 512 GB is paid for.
_p1f_note: Gate P1F's gradients (carhybrid/FINE_ADJOINT.md): the production-mesh DAFoam gradient of the team car on frames 1-3 (frame 0 is f0_team_bg12.889_k0). Run only after f0 passes F0-F3. The line candidates along their mean are ordinary 'score' cases (hosted runners).
_aws_scaling_note: How DAFoam's time scales with MPI ranks (the instance-size question), measured: the team car, frame 0, bg_div 10.23 (~1.24 M cells), the same score each time (128 ranks), DAFoam on 128 / 64 / 32 ranks. Run on a 128-core machine (TYPE=m7a.32xlarge) with STOP_ON_FAIL=0; resources.json gives each phase's wall time and dafoam_gmres.json the seconds per GMRES iteration and the iteration count at each rank count. About 3-5 h, a few USD on spot.
_sweep5_note: sweep4's 32 layouts with evo_patches/legality_fixes.py (L1 rear wing ahead of the body's back, L2 body clamped to the official block, L3 wheel-support variants, L4 front-wing segment); sweep4: 16/32 legal
_bo_note: P3 (carhybrid/bo.py, carhybrid/BO.md): batches bo_<n> and bo_confirm are written by bo.py advance; its state is carhybrid/bo/state.json and designs.jsonl
_sweep5r_note: the 4 cars still illegal in sweep5, with legality_fixes L5 (rear wing forward when unsupported) and L3 v2 (deeper saddles)
_wing1_note: evo_patches/rear_wing_shape.py on GitHub: 12 legal sweep5 layouts with random rear-wing shapes (bend, sweep, taper, thickness, camber of either sign; AoA 0) and random strut numbers, and 4 under-wing pylons at 0.95/0.85/0.7/0.5 of the half span (strict T9.5.1: the engine must refuse the ones that leave < 50 mm unbroken, the referee must agree). Build only.
